'''Forward Visual Triangulation Site Number One''', or simply '''Forward Visual One''', was a [[forward visual triangulation site]] located on the [[Cruiser/Legends|Chiss attack cruiser]] ''[[Springhawk/Legends|Springhawk]]'' of the [[Chiss Expansionary Fleet/Legends|Chiss Expansionary Fleet]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Beautiful, isn't it? Please; be seated.''&raquo;<br />&laquo;''Thank you. May I ask why you sent for me?''&raquo;<br />&laquo;''To share this view, of course. And to answer a few questions.|translated=1|Force Commander Mitth'raw'nuruodo and Jorj Car'das|<ref name="OF" />}}
The [[forward visual triangulation site]] housed a convex floor-to-ceiling [[Viewport/Legends|viewport]] and was lit by dim lights. A long, curved couch was located in front of the viewport. [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jorj Car'das]] compared the room to a compact version of [[Passenger liner/Legends|starliner]]'s observation gallery.<ref name="OF" />

==History==
{{Quote|Commander Mitth'raw'nuruodo's respects. He requests your presence in Forward Visual One.|translated=1|The messenger, to Jorj Car'das|<ref name="OF" />}}
[[File:Jorj.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Jorj Car'das (pictured) was questioned by Mitth'raw'nuruodo in the Forward Visual Triangulation Site Number One.]]
In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="Outbound Flight date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> following the [[skirmish between Progga and Picket Force Two|skirmish]] between [[Progga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] and [[Picket Force Two/Legends|Picket Force Two]] of the [[Chiss Expansionary Fleet/Legends|Chiss Expansionary Fleet]], the crew of the [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] ''[[Bargain Hunter]]'', [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Merchant/Legends|traders]] and smugglers [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Dubrak Qennto]], [[Maris Ferasi]], and Jorj Car'das were brought aboard the [[Cruiser/Legends|Chiss attack cruiser]] ''[[Springhawk/Legends|Springhawk]]'' and granted a temporary living quarters. After being held in their quarters for a time, Corellian smuggler Jorj Car'das was informed by a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Unidentified Chiss messenger|messenger]] that [[Force Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]], [[Core name/Legends|core name]] "Thrawn," requested his presence in Forward Visual One in the [[Sy Bisti/Legends|Sy Bisti]] [[Trade language/Legends|trade language]].<ref name="OF" />

While he was escorted to the room, Car'das expected Forward Visual to be a crowded, high-tech room, but instead found himself in a room that looked like a compact version of starliner's observation gallery. In the room, Car'das was greeted by Thrawn, who summoned him to question Car'das on their true mission to determine whether he could trust the group. Car'das was still surprised by the existence of such a room aboard a [[Warship/Legends|warship]]. Thrawn explained the room's function and revealed its full name to Car'das.<ref name="OF" />

==Behind the scenes==
Forward Visual Triangulation Site Number One first appeared in the [[2006]] novel [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="OF" />
